column1: # D-161 mutation-pass results
- source: `/Users/arc.elixir/dev/sw-dev-blueprint@2cd9c7270e0b7340069b35b75886140034466936` (isolated exact-HEAD clone)
- baseline: green
- suite: `python3 -m pytest scripts/selftest/selftest_*.py -q`
- totals: 69 mutants; 45 killed; 23 survived; 1 authoring errors
- enforcement: report-only; survivors are evidence for oracle improvement, never a build gate
| verdict | file | mutation | reason |
| AUTHORING_ERROR | `file` | `find` → `replacement` | source file does not exist |
| KILLED | `scripts/regen-manifest.sh` | `[ ! -f "$path" ]` → `[ -f "$path" ]` | missing-file check inverted: listed files absent on disk pass, present files fail the regen |
| KILLED | `scripts/spec_artifacts.py` | `return 1 if invalid else 0` → `return 0 if invalid else 1` | exit code inverted: invalid staging reports success to refreeze |

| KILLED | `scripts/spec_artifacts.py` | `or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in parts))` → `or any(part in {"", "."} for part in parts))` | traversal guard drops "..": tests/../scripts paths become allowed staging artifacts |
| KILLED | `scripts/manifest-drift-guard.sh` | `[ "$staged_hash" != "$_hash" ]` → `[ "$staged_hash" = "$_hash" ]` | drift condition inverted: matching hashes warn, drifted hashes pass silently |

| KILLED | `scripts/tpm-view.sh` | `grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*(src\|\./src)/' "$ESC/BATCH.md" > "$VIEW/escalations/BATCH.md"` → `grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(src\|\./src)/' "$ESC/BATCH.md" > "$VIEW/escalations/BATCH.md"` | sanitization inverted: only src/ path lines kept in the TPM view, everything else dropped |

| KILLED | `scripts/tpm-view.sh` | `for doc in PRD.md ERD.md ERD-DELTA.md contracts.json; do` → `for doc in PRD.md ERD.md ERD-DELTA.md; do` | contracts.json dropped from the materialized spec-artifact set |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/new-project.sh` | `THINKING_MODEL) die "pre-flight: THINKING MODEL loaded (content empty, reasoning present). Load the non-thinking coder model (Hard Rule 1)." ;;` → `THINKING_MODEL) echo "  ok: local LLM responded" ;;` | thinking-model pre-flight dies become a pass: Hard Rule 1 guard removed |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/new-project.sh` | `[ -x scripts/bootstrap.sh ] \|\| die "scripts/bootstrap.sh missing or not executable."` → `[ -x scripts/bootstrap.sh ] \|\| die "scripts/bootstrap.sh missing."` | bootstrap pre-check message changed (teeth assert the exact onboarding output) |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/status.sh` | `if [ "${STATUS:-}" = "Running" ]; then` → `if [ "${STATUS:-}" != "Running" ]; then` | podman section condition inverted: container report shown when VM stopped, skipped when running |

| KILLED | `scripts/extract-test-functions.py` | `if name in all_top and all_top[name] not in target_funcs:` → `if name in all_top and all_top[name] in target_funcs:` | helper collection inverted: target tests collected as helpers, real helpers dropped |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/extract-test-functions.py` | `if comment_line >= 0 and lines[comment_line].lstrip().startswith("#"):` → `if comment_line >= 0 and not lines[comment_line].lstrip().startswith("#"):` | leading-comment inclusion inverted: docstring-less lines pulled in, comment headers dropped |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/check-drift.sh` | `if [ "$child" = "$head_h" ]; then` → `if [ "$child" != "$head_h" ]; then` | sync condition inverted: matching files flagged, divergent files reported IN_SYNC |
| SURVIVED | `scripts/check-drift.sh` | `status=BEHIND; behind=1` → `status=BEHIND; behind=1; rc=1` | BEHIND now fails the gate (rc=1) instead of exiting 2 |
| KILLED | `scripts/context-budget.py` | `if size > limit:` → `if size < limit:` | budget comparison inverted: warns under budget, silent over budget |
| KILLED | `scripts/context-budget.py` | `if slice_size > source_size:` → `if slice_size < source_size:` | slice sanity check inverted: valid slices rejected, oversized slices accepted |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/sandbox-run.sh` | `scripts\|scripts/*\|.git\|.git/*\|.githooks\|.githooks/*)` → `scripts\|scripts/*)` | control-plane write blocklist narrowed: .git/.githooks become agent-writable in the sandbox |
| SURVIVED | `scripts/sandbox-run.sh` | `"$repo_canon"/*) ;;` → `"$repo_canon") ;;` | escape check inverted: paths outside the repo root accepted as writable mounts |

| KILLED | `scripts/doc-consistency.sh` | `hits=$(grep -inE "$tok" "$ROOT/$doc" \|\| true)` → `hits=$(grep -ivE "$tok" "$ROOT/$doc" \|\| true)` | token match inverted: warns on every non-matching line, silent on stale tokens |
| KILLED | `scripts/doc-consistency.sh` | `if [ -n "$hits" ]; then` → `if [ -z "$hits" ]; then` | warning trigger inverted: warns when a doc is clean, silent when it is stale |

| KILLED | `scripts/standing-summary.py` | `if "architecture" not in section_heading(section).lower():` → `if "architecture" in section_heading(section).lower():` | file-map section filter inverted: non-architecture sections summarized, architecture sections skipped |
| KILLED | `scripts/standing-summary.py` | `if len(normalized) <= limit:` → `if len(normalized) >= limit:` | truncation bound inverted: long descriptions pass untruncated, short ones get cut |
| KILLED | `scripts/tpm-unpack.sh` | `if not is_allowed(path):` → `if is_allowed(path):` | path policy inverted: disallowed paths staged, allowed paths rejected |
| KILLED | `scripts/tpm-unpack.sh` | `if path in files:` → `if path not in files:` | duplicate detection inverted: first block rejected, repeats accepted |
| KILLED | `scripts/apply-edit-blocks.py` | `if n == 0:` → `if n > 0:` | missing-anchor fail-closed removed: absent SEARCH blocks pass the pre-check |
| KILLED | `scripts/apply-edit-blocks.py` | `if n > 1:` → `if n < 1:` | ambiguous-anchor fail-closed removed: multi-match SEARCH blocks pass the pre-check |

| KILLED | `scripts/check-prd-additive.py` | `if capsule and capsule not in normalize(staged):` → `if capsule and capsule in normalize(staged):` | capsule guard inverted: staged PRD passing requires the capsule to be removed |

| KILLED | `scripts/check-prd-additive.py` | `removed = sorted(standing_acs.keys() - staged_acs.keys(),` → `removed = sorted(standing_acs.keys() & staged_acs.keys(),` | removal detection inverted: kept ACs flagged removed, actually-removed ACs pass |
| KILLED | `scripts/teardown.sh` | `[ "$DRY" = "1" ] \|\| eval "$@"` → `[ "$DRY" = "0" ] \|\| eval "$@"` | dry-run guard inverted: --dry-run executes, normal runs skip |
| SURVIVED | `scripts/teardown.sh` | `    do_or_say "limactl stop dev-vm"` → `    do_or_say "limactl start dev-vm"` | teardown starts the VM instead of stopping it |

| KILLED | `scripts/link-template.sh` | `[ "$APPROVE" = "$PLAN_SHA" ] \|\| die "approval hash mismatch; preview again"` → `[ "$APPROVE" != "$PLAN_SHA" ] \|\| die "approval hash mismatch; preview again"` | approval hash check inverted: correct hash rejected, mismatched hash accepted |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/link-template.sh` | `case "$path" in ""\|/*\|../*\|*/../*\|*/..\|..) die "unsafe retired path: $path" ;; esac` → `case "$path" in ""\|/*) die "unsafe retired path: $path" ;; esac` | unsafe-path glob narrowed: traversal paths (../..) accepted for retirement |

| KILLED | `scripts/bootstrap.sh` | `git config --global --add safe.directory "$root"` → `git config --global --add safe.directory "$root-never"` | dubious-ownership fix trusts the wrong path: git still refuses the checkout |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/bootstrap.sh` | `if [ -z "$(git config user.name \|\| true)" ] \` → `if [ -n "$(git config user.name \|\| true)" ] \` | identity preflight inverted: dies when identity is set, passes when missing |
| KILLED | `scripts/mutation-pass.sh` | `if [ "$BASE_RC" -ne 0 ]; then` → `if [ "$BASE_RC" -ne 1 ]; then` | red-baseline gate weakened: rc=1 baseline treated as green, pass proceeds |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/mutation-pass.sh` | `(cd "$WORK" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 bash -c "$SUITE") > "$PASS_TMP/baseline.log" 2>&1` → `(cd "$WORK" && bash -c "$SUITE") > "$PASS_TMP/baseline.log" 2>&1` | baseline suite loses PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1: stale .pyc vacuity returns |

| KILLED | `scripts/check-swallowed-errors.py` | `if len(node.body) == 1 and isinstance(node.body[0], ast.Pass):` → `if len(node.body) == 1 and not isinstance(node.body[0], ast.Pass):` | bare-pass detection inverted: real swallows pass, non-pass handlers flagged |

| KILLED | `scripts/check-swallowed-errors.py` | `if not any("#" in ln for ln in span):` → `if any("#" in ln for ln in span):` | justification-comment check inverted: commented swallows flagged, uncommented ones pass |
| SURVIVED | `scripts/llm-call.sh` | `if not content and reasoning:` → `if content and reasoning:` | thinking-model detection inverted: reasoning-only replies pass, normal replies die |
| SURVIVED | `scripts/llm-call.sh` | `elif served != expect_model:` → `elif served == expect_model:` | seat-mismatch check inverted: correct model fails, wrong model passes |
| KILLED | `scripts/regen-manifest.sh` | `mv "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"` → `rm -f "$TMP"` | regen computes new hashes but discards them: manifest never updated |

| KILLED | `scripts/manifest-drift-guard.sh` | `staged_hash="$(git -C "$ROOT" show :"$path" 2>/dev/null \| sha256_of \|\| true)"` → `staged_hash="$(git -C "$ROOT" show "HEAD:$path" 2>/dev/null \| sha256_of \|\| true)"` | compares HEAD instead of the staged index: staged-only changes pass silently |
| SURVIVED | `scripts/status.sh` | `probe "LM Studio (default)" 1234` → `probe "LM Studio (default)" 1235` | LLM port probe moved off the documented default port |

| KILLED | `scripts/contracts-delta.py` | `if not isinstance(entry_point, str) or not entry_point.startswith("src."):` → `if isinstance(entry_point, str) and entry_point.startswith("src."):` | entry-point validation inverted: valid src. points dropped, foreign points mapped |
| KILLED | `scripts/contracts-delta.py` | `if not pin or pin in files:` → `if not pin or pin not in files:` | slice condition inverted: entries kept when their file is absent, dropped when present |
| SURVIVED | `scripts/tpm-agent.sh` | `if [ "$MODE" = view ]; then` → `if [ "$MODE" != view ]; then` | view-mode branch inverted: --view launches the plain agent, default launches the view agent |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/tpm-agent.sh` | `exec claude --settings scripts/tpm-agent-settings.json \` → `exec claude --settings scripts/tpm-agent-settings-missing.json \` | agent launched with a non-existent settings file |

| KILLED | `scripts/phase-gate.sh` | `if [ -f .placeholder-gate ]; then` → `if [ ! -f .placeholder-gate ]; then` | placeholder-gate trigger inverted: placeholder scan runs when the gate file is absent |

| KILLED | `scripts/contracts-merge.py` | `if eid in standing_by_id and canon(entry) == canon(standing_by_id[eid]):` → `if eid in standing_by_id and canon(entry) != canon(standing_by_id[eid]):` | no-op gate inverted: byte-identical staged entries pass, changed entries die as no-ops |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/feature-summary.py` | `if not d.is_dir() or d.stat().st_mtime < since_epoch:` → `if not d.is_dir() or d.stat().st_mtime > since_epoch:` | archive time window inverted: old EM calls counted, recent ones skipped |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/feature-summary.py` | `elif line.startswith("outcome=") and outcome == "ok":` → `elif line.startswith("outcome=") and outcome != "ok":` | outcome parsing inverted: explicit outcome line only applies when a gate/verdict already set one |

| KILLED | `scripts/metrics-report.py` | `if spec is not None and (not m_spec or int(m_spec.group(1)) != spec):` → `if spec is not None and (not m_spec or int(m_spec.group(1)) == spec):` | spec filter inverted: runs of the requested spec skipped, other specs counted |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/metrics-report.py` | `if outcome not in ("ok", "accepted", "valid"):` → `if outcome in ("ok", "accepted", "valid"):` | waste counting inverted: successful EM calls counted as waste, failures not |

| SURVIVED | `scripts/update-template.sh` | `[ "$APPROVE" = "$DIFF_SHA" ] \|\| die "approval hash mismatch — expected current DIFF-SHA $DIFF_SHA` → `[ "$APPROVE" != "$DIFF_SHA" ] \|\| die "approval hash mismatch — expected current DIFF-SHA $DIFF_SHA` | approval hash check inverted: correct hash rejected, mismatched hash applies the diff |
